## Problem and changed behavior

Describe the concrete problem, what this changes, and the resulting behavior.
Link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Verification

State what you ran and what passed. For semantic changes, include the failure
case and explain how origin, review scope, constraints, and unknowns are
preserved.

## Limits

Record any remaining limitation or compatibility change. Disclose significant AI
assistance. Do not include credentials, private records, or unverifiable claims
about model quality.
